podcast.body: A collaboration with The Chemical Brothers, featured on their album *Surrender*. This song is described as "tremendous" and one of The Chemical Brothers' finest, part of multiple collaborations born from a deep, long-standing friendship between Gallagher and the band. "Let Forever Big, que estaba en el Surrender, que era la canción de los que Michael Brothers en la que cantaba Noel Gallagher, es tremenda, con diferencia una de las mejores canciones que hicieron los que Michael Brothers."
